## Objective

What user-visible behavior or documented contract does this change deliver?

## Professional coverage

- [ ] Relevant product/business and user outcome considered.
- [ ] Architecture, data, security/privacy, reliability and UX concerns assessed where applicable.
- [ ] Existing tools, APIs, MCPs, datasets, standards, and open-source options researched when they could materially improve the outcome.
- [ ] Agent/contributor guidance, operations, and durable documentation updated where affected.
- [ ] Complexity and process overhead were removed where they do not create meaningful protection or value.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each acceptance criterion is checked against observable evidence.
- [ ] Tests cover the new or corrected behavior where applicable.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and examples match the implementation.
- [ ] Canonical task state was not changed without supporting evidence.
- [ ] If an assumption or roadmap gate changed, its owner, falsification evidence, scenario outcome, and dependency state are recorded in the canonical register/roadmap.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] No credentials, local environment files, private data, or generated indexes were committed.
- [ ] No unapproved external writes, deployments, paid API calls, or irreversible changes were performed.
- [ ] Schema, ID, evidence-lineage, and CLI compatibility were considered.
- [ ] Third-party reuse has a verified compatible license and provenance record, where applicable.
